chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from him عليه السلام that he said:
If you catch the Imam before he bows in the last rakʿah, then you have caught the prayer. And if you catch him after he has bowed, then it is four rakʿahs, in the position of the Dhuhr prayer.

key_terms.الرَّكْعَةَ الْأَخِيرَةَ: the final rakʿah of the prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the prayer, here referring to Jumuʿah prayer

ai.seo_question: When does a latecomer still count as having caught the Jumuʿah prayer with the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling for one who joins the Imam late in the congregational Jumuʿah prayer. If he joins before the bowing of the final rakʿah, he has attained the prayer; otherwise, he must perform it as four rakʿahs like Dhuhr.
